exceptional_and_coupled_sectors: L=0 and L=2 are scalar-recurrence degeneracies, not certified physical spin-2 exceptional modes
TT constraints couple angular components and must be imposed in the full tensor recursion
the physical angular spectrum must be recomputed with tensor or spin-weighted harmonics
soft/memory and Coulombic data are not exhausted by the p=0 scalar-amplitude branch

full_tensor_completion_gate.promotion_rule: full_tensor_bondi_recursion_constructed remains false until all required objects have exact machine checks
full_tensor_completion_gate.reason: Cartesian TT scalar amplitudes do not supply the Bondi radial constraint hierarchy, residual gauge action, or physical spin-2 angular spectrum
required_objects: linear Bondi-gauge ansatz for h_uu, h_ur, h_uA, and trace-free h_AB
all independent linearized Bach rows expanded in inverse radius
tensor or spin-weighted spherical-harmonic angular operators
boundary-preserving residual Diff x Weyl transformations
decision whether the reduced p=1 kappa datum survives the tensor constraints

kinematic_boundary_selection.condition: delta h_tilde_AB restricted to null infinity is zero in the selected completion
kinematic_boundary_selection.does_not_exclude: the u-independent kappa datum inside the p=1 Bach recursion
kinematic_boundary_selection.effect: excludes the leading p=0 boundary-metric deformation while retaining p=1 falloff
kinematic_boundary_selection.locality: radial falloff condition at null infinity, not a future endpoint condition
kinematic_boundary_selection.representative_falloff: in the chosen flat Cartesian TT representative, h_ij=O(r^-1)

p0_extra_bach_falloff.scalar_exception: L=0 permits only u-independent leading f_0 at these orders
p0_extra_bach_falloff.wave_image: Box phi=-2 r^-1 d_u f_0-L r^-2 f_0+O(r^-3 from f_1)
p0_extra_bach_falloff.wave_kernel_conclusion: for L nonzero, a nonzero p=0 leading datum cannot lie in the wave kernel

p1_einstein_compatible_falloff.bach_allows: kappa is arbitrary u-independent angular data in this scalar recursion
p1_einstein_compatible_falloff.formal_extension: for every later j>=1 the coefficient of d_u^2 f_j is 4(j+1)j, which is nonzero, so the scalar recursion can be continued without imposing an algebraic condition on kappa
p1_einstein_compatible_falloff.interpretation: Einstein-compatible falloff containing both the Einstein wave subspace and a same-falloff non-Einstein Bach datum

radiative_root_definition: f_0(u,x) is treated as freely variable radiative data, so the coefficient of d_u^2 f_0 must vanish identically

retarded_coordinates.metric: ds^2=-du^2-2 du dr+r^2 q_AB dx^A dx^B

scope_guards: exact for the scalar amplitude of each flat Cartesian TT polarization
p=1 is Einstein-compatible falloff, not an Einstein-sector equivalence
not the complete tensor Bondi gauge or BV complex
no nonlinear or global scattering theorem

series_recursions.equation_rule: sum of the listed terms equals zero

machine_check.method: direct coefficient extraction from finite retarded series
